## Functions
### onlyHubChain

Modifier to restrict certain functions to only be called on the hub chain.
This ensures that governance actions like proposing, executing, and canceling can only happen
on the designated hub chain, while other chains act as spokes that can only receive and execute
proposals that have been approved on the hub.


```solidity
modifier onlyHubChain() ;
```

### onlySatelliteChain

Modifier to restrict certain functions to only be called on satellite chains (non-hub chains).
This ensures that certain operations can only happen on spoke chains that receive and execute
proposals from the hub chain.


```solidity
modifier onlySatelliteChain() ;
```

### constructor


```solidity
constructor(GovernorParams memory params)
    Governor("SummerGovernor")
    GovernorSettings(params.votingDelay, params.votingPeriod, params.proposalThreshold)
    GovernorVotes(params.token)
    GovernorVotesQuorumFraction(params.quorumFraction)
    GovernorTimelockControl(params.timelock)
    OApp(params.endpoint, address(params.initialOwner))
    DecayController(address(params.token))
    Ownable(address(params.initialOwner));
```

### sendProposalToTargetChain

Sends a proposal to another chain for execution


```solidity
function sendProposalToTargetChain(
    uint32 _dstEid,
    address[] memory _dstTargets,
    uint256[] memory _dstValues,
    bytes[] memory _dstCalldatas,
    bytes32 _dstDescriptionHash,
    bytes calldata _options
)
    external
    onlyGovernance
    onlyHubChain;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_dstEid`|`uint32`|The destination Endpoint ID|
|`_dstTargets`|`address[]`|The target addresses for the proposal|
|`_dstValues`|`uint256[]`|The values for the proposal|
|`_dstCalldatas`|`bytes[]`|The calldata for the proposal|
|`_dstDescriptionHash`|`bytes32`|The description hash for the proposal|
|`_options`|`bytes`|Message execution options|

### castVote

Casts a vote for a proposal


```solidity
function castVote(
    uint256 proposalId,
    uint8 support
)
    public
    override(ISummerGovernor, Governor)
    updateDecay(_msgSender())
    onlyHubChain
    returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`proposalId`|`uint256`|The ID of the proposal to vote on|
|`support`|`uint8`|The support for the proposal (0 = against, 1 = for, 2 = abstain)|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The proposal ID|


### propose

Proposes a new governance action


```solidity
function propose(
    address[] memory targets,
    uint256[] memory values,
    bytes[] memory calldatas,
    string memory description
)
    public
    override(Governor, ISummerGovernor)
    updateDecay(_msgSender())
    onlyHubChain
    returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targets`|`address[]`|The addresses of the contracts to call|
|`values`|`uint256[]`|The ETH values to send with the calls|
|`calldatas`|`bytes[]`|The call data for each contract call|
|`description`|`string`|A description of the proposal|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|proposalId The ID of the newly created proposal|


### execute

Executes a proposal. Only callable on the proposal chain

Crosschain proposals are executed using LayerZero. Check _lzReceive for the execution logic


```solidity
function execute(
    address[] memory targets,
    uint256[] memory values,
    bytes[] memory calldatas,
    bytes32 descriptionHash
)
    public
    payable
    override(Governor, ISummerGovernor)
    updateDecay(_msgSender())
    onlyHubChain
    returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targets`|`address[]`|The addresses of the contracts to call|
|`values`|`uint256[]`|The ETH values to send with the calls|
|`calldatas`|`bytes[]`|The call data for each contract call|
|`descriptionHash`|`bytes32`|The hash of the proposal description|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|proposalId The ID of the executed proposal|
